hero.title: The data spine behind Montenegro's public finance.
hero.body: For fifteen years our software has moved tax receipts, central-bank settlements and ministerial budgets across the country — measured in billions of euro, audited to ISO 27001, never down.

platform.title: Four stages. One accountable team.
platform.body: Every engagement runs through the same four stages — no handoffs to subcontractors, no surprises after sign-off.

items.name: Discovery
items.description: We sit with stakeholders, map constraints, and write down what success looks like before a single line of code is committed.

items.name: Architecture
items.description: Data models, integrations, security boundaries and failure modes are drawn out and signed off — not invented mid-build.

items.name: Build
items.description: Engineering measured against acceptance criteria, hardened against the threat model, reviewed by an internal red team before release.

items.name: Operate
items.description: Deployment, monitoring, training and ongoing partnership — fifteen years of running critical systems means we know what 3 a.m. looks like.

clients.title: We do not have many clients. We have the right ones.

security.title: Built to be audited.
security.body: Two parallel ISO regimes, Bitdefender enterprise across endpoints and servers, an internal red team that breaks our own code before anyone else can.

pillars.v: Information security management, certified and externally audited annually.
Quality management across the full delivery lifecycle.
Enterprise endpoint and server protection across all production estate.

contact.title: If you run something critical, we should talk.
contact.body: We respond to procurement enquiries within one business day. For incident-related contact use the 24/7 line.
contact.office: Bulevar Svetog Petra Cetinjskog, Podgorica, Montenegro

technology.title: The stack underneath.
technology.body: Stable, well-understood tooling — chosen for longevity, audit-trail and operational predictability over novelty.

tiers.label: Application
tiers.note: Custom operator consoles, internal admin and reporting surfaces.

tiers.label: Data
tiers.note: Primary store — transactional integrity, point-in-time recovery, externally audited.

tiers.label: Security
tiers.note: Endpoint and server protection across the production estate, under externally audited control regimes.

footer.tagline: National financial infrastructure, built in Podgorica.
